question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

“Meena, will you assist me to pack our belongings?” asked her mother.

options.text: Meena's mother asked her whether she will assist her to pack their belongings.
Meena's mother asked her whether if she would assist her to pack their belongings
Meena's mother asked her whether she would assist her to pack their belongings.
Meena's mother asked her whether she can assist her to pack their belongings.

solution:
The correct answer is option 3) 'Meena's mother asked her whether she would assist her to pack their belongings.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an interrogative sentence in Direct Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'whether' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• In the Indirect speech 'asked' will not be changed because the reporting verb has no object.
 
• The subject **'her mother'** will be changed into **'Meena's mother.'**
 
• Also a reflexive pronoun **'her'** will be added to address the question in the indirect speech.
 
• The indirect speech will begin like 'Meena's mother asked her whether.'
 
• Now we have to change the reported speech.
 
• Here the pronoun 'you' will be changed into 'she' and 'me' will be changed into 'her.'
 
• Also, 'our' will be changed into 'their'
 
• The future tense 'will' will be changed to the past tense 'would'.
 
• Here, 'will you assist me to pack our belongings?' is in an interrogative sentence and will be changed into an assertive sentence i.e., 'she would assist her to pack their belongings.'
 
• Finally, the indirect speech is 'Meena's mother asked her whether she would assist her to pack their belongings.'
 
• So, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Meena's mother asked her whether she would assist her to pack their belongings.*
